conversation.message: How have you been feeling lately, overall?
I'd say I'm mostly good, just a bit... I don't know, just a bit restless sometimes. It's not bad, just a bit of energy left over, you know?
Can you tell me more about that restless feeling—does it make it hard to enjoy things you usually like?

Not really. I still love hiking, for example. It’s just... sometimes I look at my phone and I'm like, 'Why am I wasting my time scrolling?' It's just a little bit of a struggle to stay focused, I guess.
Is it harder to focus or concentrate than it used to be?
Yeah, definitely. It's like my mind is a bit of a jumble. I used to be able to sit down and focus on a book for hours, but now I get distracted pretty easily.
How long has it been since you could focus on a book like that?
A few months, I think? It’s not a big deal, just something I've noticed.
How have you been sleeping lately?
It's been pretty good, actually. I wake up a bit early sometimes, but I don't have trouble falling asleep.
When you wake up early, are you able to fall back asleep?
Yeah, I can usually fall back asleep pretty easily.
Been doing anything you enjoy lately?
Yeah, I went hiking this weekend. It was really nice to get out of the city.
Was it hard to find the motivation to go?
Not really. I just needed to get out of my head for a bit.
When you think about the next few weeks, what do you expect day to day?
I think it'll be busy, but I'm okay with that.
What kind of busy feels okay to you?
Just the usual stuff, like work and seeing friends.
Do you find it harder to make decisions than before, even small ones?
No, not really. I think I'm still pretty decisive.
So you feel your decision-making is still as sharp as it's always been?
Yeah, definitely.
Do you feel like you have enough energy for your usual day?
Yeah, I have plenty of energy.
What does a typical day look like for you?
Just work, mostly. I try to keep things simple, so I don't overexert myself.
Are you still into the things you used to care about?
Yeah, I still love art. It's the one thing that doesn't make me feel restless.
What kind of art brings you that sense of calm?
Painting. It’s really meditative for me.
Is there anything weighing on your mind that you wish you could change?
Just the usual things, like the state of the world. It’s not really heavy, though.
When you think about the state of the world, what part of it sits with you the most?
Just the fact that there’s a lot of work to be done.
How do you feel about how things have gone for you recently?
I think I'm doing okay. There are definitely things I could be doing better, but I’m proud of what I've achieved so far.
What's one thing you feel you could be doing better right now?
Probably my social life. I've been a bit distant from my friends lately.
How's your appetite been?
It's been good. I'm eating well.
Have you noticed any changes in what you're craving or how much you're eating?
No, not really.
Have you found yourself getting emotional more easily lately?
No, not really.
So you haven't noticed any big changes in how you feel day-to-day?
No, I think I'm pretty stable.
Do you feel physically restless or on edge in your body?
Not really.
Can you tell me more about what "not really" feels like for you?
It’s just a slight itch, like I need to move. But it’s nothing I can’t handle.
Is it worse when you have to sit still or wait?
I guess so. It’s just annoying, you know?
What kind of annoying feeling do you notice when you have to wait?
Just a bit of impatience.
What kinds of things set you off lately that wouldn't have bothered you before?
Just the usual stuff. Traffic, lines, things like that.
Can you tell me more about what happens when you're stuck in traffic?
I just get a bit annoyed, but I don't let it ruin my day.
How long does the irritable feeling last after it starts?
Just a few minutes.
Does it feel like it comes and goes in waves, or is it a single, brief spike?
It's a single spike.
When you read or work, how often do you have to re-read or restart?
Not often.
Can you give me an example of when it does happen?
Maybe once every few weeks, if I'm really tired.
Is it worse at certain times of day?
Not really.
So you feel your concentration is pretty consistent throughout the day?
Yeah, it is.
Can you tell me more about what that experience has felt like for you?
It just feels normal.
When you say it feels normal, what does that normal feel like for you?
Just a sense of stability.
What do you do to unwind or have fun?
I go hiking, usually.
When you think about the future, what comes to mind?
Just the usual stuff, like what I want to achieve.
